description: Returns the source of the app's live deploy as {path: content}, with the deploy id to pass to update_app_files as expected_deploy_id. Large apps return the file list only: ask again with paths for the files you need. Secrets (.env files, env values) are never returned.

app.description: The app's slug: the first label of its address (my-app for https://my-app.fuast.com). list_apps shows the slugs you can use.

edit_token.description: The edit_token deploy_app returned when it deployed a preview without an account. It is a secret: keep it in this conversation only.

paths.description: Only return these files. Leave out for every file.

name: get_app_source
title: Get an app's source files
